About AFTCO’s Coastal Layer 1/4 Zip Giveaway
Since 1958, AFTCO — the American Fishing Tackle Company — has crafted both apparel that protects anglers from the elements and precision-built tackle that’s designed to catch the fish of a lifetime.

The company brings its rich legacy of authentic innovation and product design to its Coastal Layer quarter zip. The fishing fleece shirt is a perfect standalone piece for crisp fall days, and works just as well as a critical component to your winter layering kit. It’s made with lightweight, moisture-wicking fleece; that 90% polyester and 10% spandex blend dries quickly for comfortable, everyday use.

The AFTCO giveaway dates ran from Nov. 9 to 23. Five winners were selected at random from all eligible entries. Each received a Coastal Layer ¼ Zip fishing fleece shirt valued at $59. This giveaway was open to entrants from the U.S. This giveaway has ended.
